title: Objective Auto-run controls UI hardening — fail-closed canonical controls + versioned exact-body idempotency
description: Owner-facing Auto-run controls on /app/objectives/:id, canonical GET /auto-policy polled 5s while visible (abort-per-tick). R1: READY/NOT READY eligibility + driver_missing verbatim; controls only on verified canonical status (cockpit snapshot labeled non-authoritative, never authorizes); IDENTITY_MISMATCH typed failure. R2: pendingCfg restores unresolved Configure limits/version/key on reopen (no default reset); ConfirmDialog.confirmDisabled + in-runPolicy canonical/context guard locks open dialogs on GET failure (zero POST, incl. force-click). R3: limits canonicalized to serialized object before signing — 09/0.50 replay identical bytes+key. R4: operation identity = action+objective+CAS policy_version+canonical limits; unresolved ops preserved under their own keys (pending Configure retried verbatim via limits-equality match even across version drift); new op on newer canonical mints fresh key bound to current CAS; committed response validated vs expected post-action state+identity else discarded+refetched (INCONSISTENT_RESPONSE — never reports committed on inconsistent state). Adversarial e2e: 403/500 zero-POST, driver_ready≠running, lost-response replay no duplicate transition, CAS→new key, identity mismatch, hidden-tab pause/resume, open-dialog lock/recover, normalized-input replay, v1-lost→pause→v3-enable new-key→ENABLED v4. Zero backend/scheduler/schema changes. objectives.spec.ts 35/35 pass full suite (baseline 'policy HALT' flake did not reproduce; documented P15.9-B5.4, passes isolated); tsc+vite clean.
